title: FlyWP Docker Compose App template
description: The template.json of one template. FlyWP reads the services from docker-compose.yml.

slug.description: The name of the folder: lower case letters, digits and hyphens.

version.description: The version of the template (not of the app). Make it higher in each change.

category.description: The filter of the template list. A new category needs a change of this schema.

description.description: Two or three sentences: what the app does and who it is for.

licence_note.description: What the licence means for the customer.

cpu.description: The CPU cores that the app needs at least.

memory_mb.description: The memory limits (mem_limit) of the services together, in MB.

disk_gb.description: The disk that the app needs at least, in GB.

domain_service.description: The service that the domain of the app goes to.

domain_port.description: The port of that service (in its expose).

settings.description: The values that the person types at the create.

secret.description: The value is a password: FlyWP saves it as a secret.

secrets.description: The values that FlyWP makes at the create, saved as secrets.

kind.description: password: 32 letters and digits. hex-32: 32 random bytes as hex. base64-32 and base64-64: random bytes as base64.

url_setting.description: The variable that gets the address of the app (https://<domain>).

host_setting.description: The variable that gets the domain of the app.

whats_new.description: What this version of the template changes. Shown with the update offer.

first_steps.description: What the person does when the app runs: the first sign-in, who becomes the admin.

security.description: This version fixes a security problem: FlyWP shows its update in red.
